products.label: Caldwell & Romanowsky (2016) globular clusters of M31, CDS J/ApJ/824/42
products.process: Place each cluster at its sky position, at the depth M31's own cluster bank draws for it from the system's published projected profile.
limitations: A cluster's depth is drawn from the system's radial profile, not measured.

products.label: Baumgardt & Vasiliev (2021) globular clusters of the Milky Way
products.process: Place each cluster at its sky position and its measured distance.
limitations: The distances carry the errors the table gives, a few per cent for most clusters.

products.label: Ramos et al. (2022) RR Lyrae of the Sagittarius stream, CDS J/A+A/666/A64
products.process: Place each RR Lyrae star the authors give to the stream with a probability above 0.9 at its sky position and its own photometric distance.
limitations: Each distance is good to about 9%, which stretches every clump along the line to the Sun.
The probability threshold is a presentation choice.

products.label: The three banks as one field
products.process: Join the three banks; of the stream stars keep one in four, in catalogue order.
limitations: Keeping one stream star in four is a presentation choice.

products.label: The Local Group's structures as dots
products.process: Write the field as the one bank the world draws once the camera is outside the Milky Way.
limitations: The field is not drawn from inside the Milky Way, where the galaxy draws its own clusters and stars.
